channel.title: Perfect Entry Learn
channel.description: Practical guides to trading charts, signals, research and prop firm planning.

item.title: Free forex charts: build a useful workspace before adding more indicators
item.description: Build a free forex chart workspace with candles, RSI, moving averages and drawing tools. Learn what to check in your data and when paid indicators add value.

item.title: How to use RSI across multiple timeframes without chasing every signal
item.description: Understand RSI, closed-candle readings and multiple-timeframe analysis. Build a testable forex chart routine with free RSI studies in Perfect View.

item.title: Win rate vs expectancy: how to tell what a trading result really means
item.description: See why a high win rate can lose money. Calculate trading expectancy in R with worked examples, costs, breakeven rates and a checklist for signal results.

item.title: How to backtest a forex strategy: a practical checklist for believable results
item.description: Build a forex backtest with explicit rules, realistic costs, closed-candle timing and out-of-sample checks. Use the checklist before trusting a trading result.

item.title: Prop firm consistency rules: calculate the profit you still need
item.description: Calculate a best-day consistency percentage, required total profit and remaining profit. Work through a 20% example and plan with the free payout calculator.

item.title: How to evaluate forex signals: currency strength, evidence and the role of CurrencyAI
item.description: Evaluate forex signals using currency context, expectancy, costs and a complete record. Understand CurrencyAI’s filtering role and inspect its public results.
